note: Offline study: no network download. Every price/FX/CPI/rate input is an existing committed research file, restored unchanged from the branch research/band_h2_combo_v1 (which checked them out of research/gain_band_v3 unchanged); the SHA-256 values were re-computed in this worktree. Uses: stress_robustness_v1_daily.csv (QQQ/SPY/QLD open, close, dividend bars: the main window, both bootstraps and the QQQ series behind the synthetic QLD*), stress_robustness_v1_dtb3.csv (DTB3: synthetic-Qld* financing, the OOS/instrument financing, and the new idle-cash yield rate), after_tax_tr_v1_usdtry_cbrt.csv (USD/TRY conversion of gains, tax payments and the interest income), after_tax_tr_v1_yiufe.csv (Yi-UFE indexation and the deflated bracket ceilings and declaration bars), ewma_band_v1_{gspc,index,tb3ms}.csv (the six OOS windows), range_vol_v2_*.csv (19) + range_vol_v1_{spy,dia,iwm}.csv (the 21 quality-passing ETFs; EWC excluded by range_vol_v2's fixed rule). The TRY/Yi-UFE calendar starts 2000-01 / 1999-01, so no after-tax stage starts before 2000-03-09. Two entries are derived evidence rather than inputs: K_ANCHORS.json (the control's published cells, generated from research/band_h2_combo_v1/RESULTS.json by cell-by-cell path mapping) and research/band_h2_combo_v1/RESULTS.json itself (the source of those anchors).

data/historical/after_tax_tr_v1_usdtry_c.source_url: CBRT USD/TRY forex buying rate (as recorded by after_tax_tr_v1)
data/historical/after_tax_tr_v1_usdtry_c.used_by: tax_engine.load_market -> USD/TRY conversion of gains, tax payments and the credited interest

data/historical/after_tax_tr_v1_yiufe.cs.source_url: TUIK Yi-UFE monthly index (as recorded by after_tax_tr_v1; TCMB/TUIK chained)
data/historical/after_tax_tr_v1_yiufe.cs.used_by: tax_engine -> Yi-UFE indexation of the acquisition month, the deflated bracket ceilings, and the 22,000 x scale(year) TRY declaration bar of Z2

data/historical/ewma_band_v1_tb3ms.csv.used_by: gate G7: TB3MS pre-1954 T-bill rate for the M2 window (and the cash-yield rate there)

data/historical/stress_robustness_v1_dai.used_by: trend_robustness_v2.load() -> QQQ/SPY/QLD open, close, dividend bars (main window and both bootstraps)

data/historical/stress_robustness_v1_dtb.source_url: FRED DTB3 (3-Month Treasury Bill Secondary Market Rate, discount basis)
data/historical/stress_robustness_v1_dtb.used_by: trend_robustness_v2.load() -> DTB3 financing rate; the OOS T-bill fallback; and this study's idle-cash yield rate: d3 = DTB3, rate[i] = max(0, DTB3[i-1] - spread) / 252. Main-window mean DTB3 1.915 %/yr (6,642 obs), 2015-09..2021 mean 0.896 %, 2022-01..2026-09 mean 3.977 %, last 4.10 %

external_documentation.alpaca_fdic_sweep_faq: https://alpaca.markets/support/fdic-sweep-program-faq (August 2026) and https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/docs/fdic-sweep-program (updated 2026-07-07): interest accrues daily on the day's ending swept balance, is realized monthly on the last business day of the month and stays invested to compound; Individual and business trading accounts; USD base currency; opt-in

external_documentation.turkish_tax: GIB Menkul Sermaye Iradi Vergi Rehberi 2026 (Yayin No 584) section 3.2: MSI that is neither withheld in Turkey nor exempt -- explicitly including 'yurt disindan elde edilen diger menkul sermaye iratlari' and 'her turlu alacak faizleri' -- is declared when the total exceeds 18,000 TL (22,000 TL for 2026); the figure is a declaration bar, not an exemption, and the whole amount is declared once it is passed
